title: File:SAN MARTIN DE LOS ANDES LACAR.JPG
claims: A snow-capped conical peak across a lake, with a pebble beach and dark green trees in the foreground; the Commons description places the photograph in San Martín de los Andes, Lácar department, Neuquén. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file SAN MARTIN DE LOS ANDES LACAR.JPG. The route page uses it as San Martín de los Andes and Lácar lake context for the start/finish town; it does not show RCM4, the 2027 start line, Plaza San Martín or race-day conditions.

The Commons author field reads Alasmalko (Commons gives no machine-readable author; assumed from copyright claims); the file is marked public domain; the relevant date is 2006-03-15; the file page gives no camera coordinates; the original is 2,048 × 1,536 px; 463,037 bytes.
